result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban street with a well-maintained sidewalk and mature street trees on one side. While the narrow roadway likely encourages low vehicle speeds, the lack of marked crosswalks and visual obstructions from parked vans on the right create potential risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Large parked vans on the right side of the street block sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: No designated or marked crossing points are visible, which may lead to unpredictable pedestrian movements.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks to define pedestrian right-of-way and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near potential crossing points to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve sightlines.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street with sidewalks and a curb ramp featuring tactile paving, but it lacks marked crosswalks and traffic control signage. A significant safety hazard is present due to a large van parked at the corner, which severely obstructs sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicle
hazards.description: A large white van is parked immediately adjacent to the curb ramp, completely blocking sightlines between pedestrians and approaching vehicles.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Despite the presence of a curb ramp with tactile paving, there are no painted crosswalk markings to alert drivers to pedestrian activity.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian path and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Traffic Control Signage
